subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about winning lapsed learners back into validated paid subscriptions for {Brand}. The one point worth repeating: we optimize to the reactivated paid subscription and read each one back through store server-side validation, netting out refunds and failed renewals before it counts, so optimization trains only on confirmed subscriptions. Illustratively that lands us around a 44% trial-to-paid on the recovered cohort. Happy to pull the streak-to-renewal recovery view for your lapsed pool. Worth a quick look?
angle: warm bump, restate reactivated-paid-subscription validation proof
illustrative_flags: trial-to-paid conversion 44% on the recovered cohort (MobUpps, illustrative)
register_notes: Stage 1 EN education retargeting: references prior outreach in first sentence; restates single proof (optimize to reactivated paid subscription + store server-side validation netting refunds/failed renewals); one illustrative MobUpps figure (44% trial-to-paid), flagged; soft CTA, 1 question mark; no sign-off; native US register; no X-not-Y.
